items.text: the ground in colour: in color, a ground row of swatches (dark, paper, rose, cobalt, ember, violet, ochre, lime, sky, ink); hold one for any colour. Looks keep their ground
a new line for Current, on cards and link previews: G-code in. Beats and dancing particles out. The field is your playground.
cards: the field in colour (a dark, a vivid colour that clashes with the ground, and white), zoomed so it runs off the edges, framed differently on each design, some with the field's arrows
the duck-rabbit is anchored at its heart, the corner where its back meets its neck, at the centre of the card; on story cards its head is the centre
on ochre, lime and sky cards the code sits straight on the colour, no white square
duck-rabbit cards: the look runs inside and outside the duck on two contrasting grounds; the duck is as big as the card allows without touching the type, the marks or the code, its head at the centre
card colours: rose, cobalt, ember, violet, ochre, lime, sky or ink; the look's lines glow over the colour
the namemark and CHAMY·XYZ are a little bigger and set by the brand rule (CHAMY·XYZ's capitals match the namemark's lowercase); CURRENT is a little smaller
cards: a slider of every design to pick from (four sizes, two styles) instead of one big card
add a message to a card; it takes the place of the sentence
cards carry the corner namemark (the index's, top right), not the centred one
every panel's title starts with the icon of the button that opens it
the sound panel's tabs show their icons; only the open tab shows its name too
the drawer caret sits clear of its button
